facades.name: Prins Hendrikkade front
facades.note: The whole 8.2 m front. Rows as the model's: the two glazed leaves of the oak entrance door (no fanlight); four storeys of the five-window grid plus the stair shaft's tall light beside it (the shaft lights sit 0.1-0.5 m higher than the grid row, landings); the small square light at the top of the shaft. Axes from the east end (crop px/50 x 1.04): grid 1.33, 2.18, 3.04, 3.91, 4.76 m, shaft 6.95 m.
